dsp GenReedSaxReedyVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 900.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.4) * 1.3) * 0.4774

dsp GenReedBassoonSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.5) * 1.3) * 0.4651

dsp GenReedBassoonSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.5) * 1.3) * 0.4646

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.5) * 1.3) * 0.4648

dsp GenReedBassoonBrassyVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.04 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((phA * 2.0 - 1.0)) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2l + v1f * 0.5) * 1.3) * 0.4640

dsp GenReedHarmoniumSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0015 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l

dsp GenReedAccordionSoftStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.004 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    let pre := (v2l + v1f * 0.2) * 1.3
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.3491

dsp GenReedAccordionSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.004 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    let pre := (v2l + v1f * 0.2) * 1.3
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.3480

dsp GenReedAccordionReedyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.004 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    let pre := (v2l + v1f * 0.2) * 1.3
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.3478

dsp GenReedAccordionReedyVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.004 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.08) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    let pre := (v2l + v1f * 0.2) * 1.3
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.3470

dsp GenReedAccordionBrassyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.004 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 1.32) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1500.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    let pre := (v2l + v1f * 0.2) * 1.3
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.3467

dsp GenReedMelodicaSoftVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.3 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state ve : F32 := 0.0
  state i1l : F32 := 0.0
  state i2l : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.03 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.4 / sr)
    let veA := ve + (envA - ve) * (1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.35 * sr)))
    set ve := veA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.005 * veA)
    let phA := fract(ph + f / sr)
    set ph := phA
    let ph2A := fract(ph2 + f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph2 := ph2A
    let src := ((select(lt(phA, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.6 + (select(lt(ph2A, 0.42), 1.0, 0.0 - 1.0) + 0.16) * 0.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.015
    let gl := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, f * 4.0 * (0.5 + colour) * (0.4 + 0.8 * envA) * 0.9) / sr))
    let kl := 0.9
    let al := 1.0 / (1.0 + gl * (gl + kl))
    let v1l := al * (i1l + gl * (src - i2l))
    let v2l := i2l + gl * v1l
    set i1l := 2.0 * v1l - i1l
    set i2l := 2.0 * v2l - i2l
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1100.0) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (v2l - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    let pre := (v2l + v1f * 0.25) * 1.3
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.4703

dsp GenFm1x1Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.8223

fm1x1Bass.source:
dsp GenFm1x1Bass where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6227

dsp GenFm1x2PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6475

fm1x2PadFb.source:
dsp GenFm1x2PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.5463

dsp GenFm1x3Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6748

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0

    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate

dsp GenFm1x3p5PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 3.5 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6753

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>

    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))

    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7320

dsp GenFm2x1Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7151
